text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!
Yukino Bijin was pumped up and eager
to live up to the hopes of the fans cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A huuuuge crowd came all the way out
to see us today, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Some folks might not care much about the current race, though."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is my chance
to show what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's Yukino Bijin!
She was all the buzz last year, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Waah, it really is so cute~!
I feel so lucky♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be in the "True or False Quiz"!
Please come watch, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fans A & B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, yeah...!
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...What time does it start?
Shall we go watch?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
One steady step at a time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: With the mindset of starting over from scratch...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I think the people who liked me back then
have probably lost interest by now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm not feeling down or anything!
Fads are just like that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why I wanna run so cool
that their hearts will never drift away!
...That's what I've been thinking, anyway.

True, if they're just fair-weather fans,
their interest might fade once the hype dies down.
choice_data_list: (Still... that shouldn't be all there is to it.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A'ight, time for the events—

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yukino-chan!
I came to cheer for you~! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
!
You two are...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, did you come all the way here today
just to cheer for me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fans A & B
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Things got a bit hectic so I couldn't come cheer for a while,
but Yukino-chan really is the absolute cutest!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's not just that...
It's like I just can't forget how hard she tried.
What I remember is the sight of her running."

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text: "I'll be cheering you on at the Victoria Mile too! Do your best~!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank you so much...!
It might have started out of simple trend-chasing, sure. But even so...

There are definitely fans who have fallen in love with
her running style itself. And from here on out,
their numbers are sure to grow.
choice_data_list: I gotta show the fans how cool I am.
I gotta show the fans how cool I am, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: “—And now, the True/False Quiz begins! Runners choose either True or False for each question, and if they get it wrong, they'll end up covered in mud!”

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
The next runner is Yukino Bijin-san!
Are you mentally prepared!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Splendid! Let us get started right away!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Question one! The difference between café au lait and café latte
is the type of milk used.
True or False?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That's one fancy problem right there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Both cafe au lait and cafe latte have milk in them.
I at least know that much..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, I feel like Cafe-san
taught me that a loooong time ago...?

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Yukino Bijin-san!
Please choose your answer!
True or False?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...I've made up my mind!
I'm going!!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah~...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah-waa~... Is that not right?

text_block_list.name: Host A
Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Maybe that was it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I learned a lot!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is such a good girl.
Even covered in mud like that,
she stays so positive.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there!
Be sure to get your revenge next time, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes,
thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I gotta learn more fancy words...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah~...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~!
Yay, that's the correct answer!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! The correct answer is X.
The name changes depending on whether
drip coffee or espresso is used.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Amazin'! I can't believe you answered such a fancy question correctly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to Cafe-san for telling us!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do ya think I've become a bit more city-like too...? Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Yukino Bijin!
That was such a clean and graceful run~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in the race too,
so please come cheer for me, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes~!
Do your best~!

And so, Yukino Bijin left
a lasting impression on the audience.
